# @mongez/cache

> A framework-agnostic cache facade with pluggable drivers — localStorage, sessionStorage, in-memory, and encrypted variants. One API, key prefixing, per-entry TTL, and a shape that drops into `@mongez/atom`'s `persist` slot.

This is the storage layer of the Mongez family. The state primitive lives in [`@mongez/atom`](https://github.com/hassanzohdy/atom); the encrypt/decrypt pair for the encrypted drivers lives in [`@mongez/encryption`](https://github.com/hassanzohdy/mongez-encryption).

Every export ships from the package root.

## Docs

- [Overview](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/hassanzohdy/mongez-cache/main/skills/overview.md): Pitch, install, mental model.

## Reference (by area)

- [Cache manager](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/hassanzohdy/mongez-cache/main/skills/manager.md): `cache` (default singleton), `CacheManager`, configuration (`setCacheConfigurations`, `getCacheConfigurations`, `getCacheConfig`), prefix, TTL.
  - *Auto-trigger:* code bootstraps the cache, hot-swaps the driver, or constructs sibling `CacheManager` instances with different prefixes / backends.
- [Local storage driver](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/hassanzohdy/mongez-cache/main/skills/local-storage.md): `PlainLocalStorageDriver`. localStorage-backed JSON cache.
  - *Auto-trigger:* code uses `PlainLocalStorageDriver`, or user asks about persistent cross-reload browser caching, the on-disk envelope, or localStorage quota and SSR caveats.
- [Session storage driver](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/hassanzohdy/mongez-cache/main/skills/session-storage.md): `PlainSessionStorageDriver`. Same contract, sessionStorage backend.
  - *Auto-trigger:* code uses `PlainSessionStorageDriver`, or user wants tab-scoped state (scroll position, drafts, wizard progress) that survives refresh but not tab close.
- [Runtime driver](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/hassanzohdy/mongez-cache/main/skills/runtime.md): `RunTimeDriver`. In-memory map for tests, SSR fallback, ephemeral state.
  - *Auto-trigger:* code uses `RunTimeDriver`, or user asks about in-memory cache for tests, SSR fallback in Node, or the known `has(missingKey)` bug.
- [Encryption](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/hassanzohdy/mongez-cache/main/skills/encryption.md): `EncryptedLocalStorageDriver`, `EncryptedSessionStorageDriver`, encrypt/decrypt configuration.
  - *Auto-trigger:* code uses `EncryptedLocalStorageDriver` or `EncryptedSessionStorageDriver`, or user asks how to encrypt cached tokens / PII or rotate encryption keys.
- [Custom drivers](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/hassanzohdy/mongez-cache/main/skills/custom-drivers.md): Extending `BaseCacheEngine` with IndexedDB, cookies, or remote backends.
  - *Auto-trigger:* code extends `BaseCacheEngine`, or user asks how to back the cache with IndexedDB / cookies or override the envelope / serialization.

## Recipes

- [Recipes](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/hassanzohdy/mongez-cache/main/skills/recipes.md): Multi-app prefixing, TTL per call vs. global, encrypted tokens, atom persistence wiring, SSR fallback to runtime driver.
  - *Auto-trigger:* user wants end-to-end examples — persisting `@mongez/atom` atoms, multi-app prefixing, SSR fallback, encrypted tokens, or write subscriptions.

## Quick rules

1. **Flat imports**: `import cache, { PlainLocalStorageDriver, setCacheConfigurations } from "@mongez/cache"`. No subpath entry points.
2. **One bootstrap call**: invoke `setCacheConfigurations({ driver })` once at boot, then import the default `cache` everywhere.
3. **Drivers are interchangeable**: every driver implements the same `CacheDriverInterface`. Swap at boot without touching call sites.
4. **Values are JSON-serialized by default**: objects and arrays survive round-trips. Override `valueConverter` / `valueParer` for non-JSON shapes.
5. **TTL is in seconds**: `cache.set(key, value, 60 * 15)` = 15 minutes. Set a global default via `expiresAfter` in configuration.
6. **`prefix` namespaces every key**: required when sharing a domain with other apps; the on-disk key becomes `${prefix}${key}`.
7. **Encrypted drivers need explicit encrypt/decrypt pair**: configure via `setCacheConfigurations({ encryption: { encrypt, decrypt } })`. Drivers throw if the pair is missing on first write.

## Two documented bugs

These are tested but skipped in `src/__tests__/`:

1. `EncryptedLocalStorageDriver.set` ignores `expiresAfter` — encrypted entries never expire (`drivers/EncryptedLocalStorageDriver.ts:12`).
2. `RunTimeDriver.has(missingKey)` returns `true` — base engine uses `!== null`, runtime returns `undefined` (`drivers/RunTimeDriver.ts:24`).

See the changelog for the full list.
